effects: The vault pulls exactly `assets` WETH from the signer with transferFrom, spending the signer's WETH allowance to the vault.
The vault mints Re7WETH shares to `receiver`; the share count comes from totalAssets and totalSupply at execution, with no minimum bound.
The vault supplies the WETH to Morpho Blue markets; this moves no further asset of the signer.
Before the deposit, _accrueFee mints fee shares to the feeRecipient, which dilutes the share price the signer gets.
formats.shown: Deposit: 'Deposit asset' 0.0001 WETH, 'Share ticker' Re7WETH, 'Send shares to' the receiver address.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many Re7WETH shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` No minShares parameter exists in calldata.

findings.title: deposit shows a raw constant field 'Share ticker' that gives no share amount and looks like an input.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field `{"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}`; case 0 renders 'Share ticker: Re7WETH'.
findings.fix: Remove the field and change the intent to "Deposit WETH for Re7WETH shares".

cases.notes: Signer sends 0.0001 WETH; shares go to 0xdEaD, which the screen shows and the reader understood.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns Re7WETH shares from `owner`; the share count is computed with rounding up from storage, with no maximum bound.
When the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's share allowance from `owner` by that share count.
The vault sends exactly `assets` WETH to `receiver`.
Before the withdrawal, _accrueFee mints fee shares to the feeRecipient.
formats.shown: Withdraw: 'Withdraw exactly' amount in WETH, 'To' receiver, 'Owner' owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show the Re7WETH shares burned from the owner; the vault computes the count.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` then ERC4626._withdraw `_burn(owner, shares);`. Case 1: signer out 1 Re7WETH (burn), not on screen.

cases.notes: WETH in (1 wei) is shown. The 1 wei share burn is not shown; the reader guessed shares burn with no amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` Re7WETH from `owner`.
When the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's share allowance from `owner` by `shares`.
The vault sends WETH to `receiver`; the amount is computed with rounding down from storage, with no minimum bound.
Before the redemption, _accrueFee mints fee shares to the feeRecipient.
formats.shown: Redeem: 'Shares to redeem' amount in Re7WETH, 'To' receiver, 'Owner' owner; the WETH paid out is not named.

findings.title: redeem never names WETH as the asset the receiver gets; the reader had to guess it.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem: intent "Redeem", fields only `shares`, `receiver`, `owner`. ERC4626._withdraw `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` with _asset = WETH. Case 2: signer in 2.073281987003050969 WETH; reader: 'Underlying asset (presumably WETH)'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem Re7WETH shares for WETH", or add a raw field 'Receive asset' with value `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`.

findings.title: redeem does not show the WETH amount received; the vault computes it from storage with no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Case 2: signer in 2073281987003050969 WETH, not on screen.

cases.notes: The share burn is shown exactly. The WETH received has no amount and no asset name on screen.
